title: Prefrontal activity is not only about preparing reports

statements.text: Prefrontal activity related to awareness appears without report demands in intracranial recordings, passive movie viewing and passive viewing in monkeys, and monkey prefrontal neurons encode an unreported stimulus feature about as well as the reported one.

sources.quote: even unreported stimulus features could be robustly decoded to a similar degree as attended and reported features
PFC activity in conscious perception had already survived such tests, well before their recent advocacy
